Dein Freund öffnet im Spiel mit Esc → On: Your friend opens a room in the game with Esc → Play Online Together and tells you the code. You then play Player 2 on their saved game.

Ihr spielt auf deinem Spielstand. Dein F: You play on your saved game. Your friend controls Player 2 with their own character, inventory and pathway. They see your screen; sound only plays on your side.
